schema_note: This document follows the wave10 function-handoff.v1 field set and adds five keys the wave10 shape did not need: the two decompilation_defects_corrected and unresolved_questions lists that carry the corrected evidence, observed_body.instruction_count_source, ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 and implementation.boundary_test.
semantic_label: rig block draw: two pass draw that tints every live rig block with a packed tone and then drains the remaining batch slots to the end of the slot array

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x60
abi.return_contract: MOV AL, BYTE PTR [ESP+0xf] at 0x00519630 writes only the low lane, so the model returns the widened one

observed_body.instruction_count_source: the reviewed staging handoff for this address
instruction_list: read the system, the batch at +0x10, the painter at +0x0c and the mesh at +0x20, and take the rig block array from the mesh block at +0x98
classify the mesh block word at +0x18 through 0x004bb860 and select the material 0xf01f7f52 or 0xf1cf8a9d
read the render object through 0x0067de30 and the lazy slot through the 0x0041d870 port, which always writes zero
dispatch the render object through the vtable slot +0x2c and, when it answers non-zero, read the two tune floats through 0x0040cf10 with the lazy slot value as the receiver
0x0051916a and 0x00519187 push the value stored in the lazy slot, and 0x0041d870 always leaves that slot null, so the receiver is zero

for each of the two passes, start the render on texture slot zero or one, write the colour quad (1,1,1,0) for the first pass and (1,0,0,0) for the second, set the material to 0xbc487ecb and store the two tune floats as the first parameter
bind the raster through 0x00525aa0 and raise the raster count when it is non-null
walk the rig blocks, skip the flagged ones, read the tone through 0x0040cf10 with the key 0x0d669e3c7, clamp it to zero then to 255 and quantise it with the rounding convert at 0x00519427

0x00519427 is CVTSS2SI, the x86 convert with the current rounding mode, and 0x0051942b narrows the dword result to a byte; the default mode is round to nearest even, so this is a rounding cast rather than a truncating one
pack the byte into four lanes and paint the slot extents from +0x58 and +0x5c, then drain the remaining slots to the slot array end with the colour 0xffffffff
0x00519375 subtracts the two slot array words as raw addresses and 0x00519377 shifts the byte span right by two, because the array holds four byte slot pointers
release the lazy handle through its resolved vtable when it is non-null and answer one

runtime_gates: the receiver is never dereferenced; the target reads the system through the port
all thirteen ports are dependency-only, so the two pass draw is unverified in this package
the resolved vtable comes from the 0x0041d870 port, which always leaves the lazy slot null, so the release path is only reached with a null handle in the observed configuration
the classifier key 0x438f6347 and the two tone keys are undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reads the slot array span as a slot count; the assembly subtracts the two words as raw addresses and shifts the byte span right by two, because the array holds four byte slot pointers, so the corrected model keeps the shift

the decompilation truncates the tone to a byte; the assembly converts with CVTSS2SI at 0x00519427 and narrows at 0x0051942b, which under the default rounding mode is round to nearest even, so the corrected model rounds
the decompilation passes an uninitialised receiver to the two tune reads; the assembly pushes the lazy slot value, which 0x0041d870 always leaves at zero, so the model passes zero explicitly

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
